title: Yellow Silky Slovakian Peach Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring fermented peaches and a silky mother sauce, perfect for a nostalgic treat. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is a unique and delicious dessert option.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the peach juice, sugar, and yeast, and let it ferment for 2 hours.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, semolina flour, and eggs.
Add the milk and melted butter to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and shiny.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of the fermented peach mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges by pressing with a fork.
Place the dumplings in a large pot of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the water and serve with the remaining fermented peach sauce.
